title: Different callees did not share call parentheses
symptom: decision and document declarations aligned equals signs but registry.decisions.get and resolveDocument did not share opening and closing call columns.

rootCause.summary: The original inner-call layer required identical callee signatures and arity. Heterogeneous calls therefore lacked a shared outer-call envelope.

requestedOutcome: Share outer parentheses for compatible call-valued declarations while retaining opaque argument lists and trailing non-null assertions.
decisions: Introduce declaration-call-envelope with a two-row minimum and a distinct lookup key.
Preserve legacy compatible direct-call keys; keep heterogeneous argument lists opaque.
Retain compact empty calls and exclude unsupported optional, computed, generic or comment-bearing boundaries.
